Name: Homestead Perks
Author: Jared
Description: Forty-four character-creation perks, most of them kits you carry and Place once to raise a structure with no research or building. The Homestead perk (100 Suns) starts you with a Homestead Kit that unpacks into a Cabin Kit, two Rain Cistern Kits and a stockpile of building materials, including 50 copper nails. Eighteen more are single-structure kits, each placed once with a 'Place' action: Cabin (60 Suns), Mud Hut, Cellar, Well, Forge, Furnace, Oven, Pit Trap, Log Bed, Tanning Pit, Rain Cistern, Kiln, Drying Rack, Bloomery, Enclosure and the Copper, Flint and Witchstone Mine Kits. Some refuse placement where vanilla would: inside an animal enclosure, indoors, beside a river, or away from their ore deposit. Path Kit (20 Suns) works differently: it starts you with 6 kits, each spent on a 'Build Path' action that instantly finishes the vanilla road in that direction, outdoors only. Fourteen more place vanilla stations with no research or building: Stretching Frame, Charcoal Mound, Wall Shelf, Snow Shelter, Compost Bin, Weighted Loom, Ritual Pyre, Frost Shrine, Garden Plot, Deadfall Trap, Log Boom, Tilled Field, Levee and Mushroom Bed. Ten hand you vanilla's own pieces already made: Rustic Table Kit, Bookshelf Kit, Sledge, Travois, Weaver's Workshop Kit, Sawhorses Kit, Pottery Wheel Kit, Fleshing Beam Kit, Workbench Kit and Chest Kit. Includes an extraction of Community Mod Chest's Homestead perks plus thirty-five new ones, with no other mod required.
